turns.question: How much revenue did we make per site session between 20 September and 3 October 2026?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no revenue-per-session metric, so I cannot give that figure; the closest metrics are Revenue (EUR), which was 7,172.59 EUR over 20 September to 3 October 2026, and Site sessions, which was 10 over the same period, and I have not divided one by the other.
